name: dot1vProtocolGroupTable
description: A table that contains mappings from Protocol Templates to Protocol Group Identifiers used for Port-and-Protocol-based VLAN Classification.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.5.1.1.1.name: dot1vProtocolTemplateFrameType
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.5.1.1.1.description: The data-link encapsulation format or the 'detagged_frame_type' in a Protocol Template.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.5.1.1.2.name: dot1vProtocolTemplateProtocolValue
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.5.1.1.2.description: The identification of the protocol above the data-link layer in a Protocol Template. Depending on the frame type, the octet string will have one of the following values: For 'ethernet', 'rfc1042' and 'snap8021H', this is the 16-bit (2-octet) IEEE 802.3 Type Field. For 'snapOther', this is the 40-bit (5-octet) PID. For 'llcOther', this is the 2-octet IEEE 802.2 Link Service Access Point (LSAP) pair: first octet for Destination Service Access Point (DSAP) and second octet for Source Service Access Point (SSAP).

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.5.1.1.3.name: dot1vProtocolGroupId
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.5.1.1.3.description: Represents a group of protocols that are associated together when assigning a VID to a frame.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.5.1.1.4.name: dot1vProtocolGroupRowStatus
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.5.1.1.4.description: This object indicates the status of this entry.
